other_conditions: Applicants may be individuals, partnership firms, or co‑operative societies undertaking income‑generating activities
Application must be made through the concerned State Channelizing Agencies or Channelizing Agencies
The loan is only for full‑time professional or technical courses approved by the Government in recognized institutions, both in India and abroad
Income limit of Rs 3 lakh applies to both rural and urban applicants for credit‑based schemes
benefits_summary: Provides education loans up to ₹30 lakhs for studies in India or up to ₹40 lakhs abroad (max 90% of course fee) with interest rates of 5.5‑6% for females and 6‑7% for males, and repayment periods of up to 10‑12 years.
